description: React component for managing and displaying the addition of channel members in Mattermost, including handling user mentions, invite links, and policy enforcement messaging.

classes.name: PostAddChannelMember
classes.description: React component for adding members to a channel, handling user mentions, and displaying relevant messages based on channel policies and user group memberships.

methods.name: handleAddChannelMember
methods.description: Handles adding selected users to the channel and sending ephemeral posts.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the user mention list to show all users.

methods.name: generateAtMentions
methods.description: Generates JSX elements for user mentions, handling different display formats based on number of users and expansion state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including mention links, invite options, and policy enforcement messages.
